data.one_liner: Currency text input formatter for Flutter with localization and symbol support.
data.what_it_does: Provides a text input formatter for Flutter that automatically formats numerical input into currency strings based on specified locales, decimal digits, and symbols. It also supports getting unformatted values and setting minimum or maximum limits.
use_when: You need to format user text input as currency inside a TextField or TextFormField.
You require locale-aware currency symbol and group separator handling.
avoid_when: You are not dealing with currency input fields.
You need a complex form builder framework rather than a simple input formatter.
strengths: Easy to integrate into standard Flutter TextFields via inputFormatters.
Supports customizable locales, symbols, decimal digits, and bounds.
Provides built-in helper methods to extract unformatted numeric values.
weaknesses: May require dependency overrides for the intl package depending on your project constraints.
Cursor position management can be tricky depending on input direction.
data.setup_notes: Might require dependency_overrides for the intl package if version conflicts arise.

alternatives.name: intl
alternatives.why_pick_it: For general internationalization and localized number formatting without specialized text input constraints.
